definition: Mindpixel was a web-based collaborative artificial intelligence project which aimed to create a knowledgebase of millions of human validated true/false statements, or probabilistic propositions.

explainer.lead: Mindpixel was a web-based collaborative artificial intelligence project that aimed to build a knowledgebase of millions of human-validated true/false statements, or probabilistic propositions. It ran from 2000 to 2005.

tiers.eli5: People on the internet answered millions of simple true-or-false questions so a computer could learn from their answers.
tiers.practitioner: It used distributed human validation of true/false statements to build a knowledgebase. Its 2005 end is a cautionary note about sustaining crowdsourced data collection.
tiers.paperLevel: Mindpixel was a web-based collaborative AI project aiming to create a knowledgebase of millions of human-validated true/false statements, or probabilistic propositions; it ran from 2000 to 2005.

explainer.example: A visitor answering a true/false statement online contributed one validated proposition to the knowledgebase.
